invariants.rationale: The method either returns a non-null name or a synthesized string, both of which are non-null.
Both return paths guarantee a non-empty string: either a name or a generated string describing the object.
If the returned string does not represent the name, the return expression always contains a colon separator.
If getName() is not null, the method returns it as the result.
If there is no name, the resulting string always contains the colon separator used in the fallback format.
